column1: Vetus EC4 CAN codes on the test boat
Values are hexadecimal bytes from the EC4 CAN frames. Confirmed from captures 2 and 3 (27 Sep and 2 Oct 2026).
1. Lever demand (what the helm asks for)
Byte 1 = port gear, byte 4 = starboard gear, in each helm's frame (main helm 0x181, flybridge 0x282), sent every 150 ms. Throttle is in separate bytes (2 and 5), 00 to 64 hex = 0 to 100 %.
2. Actuator status (what the gearbox is actually doing)
One byte from each actuator box (port 0x384, starboard 0x485), sent every 153.6 ms.
3. A full ahead-to-astern reversal in the actuator byte
Read top to bottom. The capture 3 timings are the gaps between these changes.

column3: The lever asked for astern (01) and the port actuator then reported astern engaged (48). First labelled astern: note 'port astern fast', capture 3.
